## Outline

- **(5m) Ollama.** `_exercises/09_ollama-local`. The same up-call question against a local model. Posit Assistant takes a local provider, so this is a dropdown change, not a different workflow. Slower and
  worse — show that honestly — and it never leaves the laptop. When that trade
  is right: embargoed data, permits, no cloud, no budget.
- **(5m) Practices and pitfalls, collected.**
  - Context is a resource you spend deliberately.
  - Documentation in the prompt beats a bigger model.
  - Never accept a number you haven't checked.
  - Keep the plan in version control alongside the code.
  - The model's confidence is uncorrelated with its correctness.
